stem: Why is Jim's demonstration with the jawbreaker important to the plot?

options.label: F
options.text: It shows the narrator that many scientific concepts are not complicated.

options.label: G
options.text: It allows the narrator to experience a moment of understanding.

options.label: H
options.text: It encourages the narrator to develop his own scientific theory about protons.

options.label: J
options.text: It gives the narrator an opportunity to help Jim with one of his projects.
